councilCandidates.name: Paul Vagianos
councilCandidates.experience: Serving as Mayor of Ridgewood; longtime Village business owner (It's Greek to Me) and former Chamber of Commerce president; focuses on downtown business vitality, pedestrian walkability, and fiscal prudence.
councilCandidates.tagline: Downtown vibrancy, balanced budgets, and collaborative non-partisan Village governance.
keyPlatformPillars: Strengthening Ridgewood's Central Business District ratables to lessen reliance on residential property taxes.
Collaborating across municipal boards to modernize Village infrastructure while preserving historic architecture.

councilCandidates.name: Pamela R. Perron
councilCandidates.experience: Deputy Mayor of Ridgewood; career attorney and former federal prosecutor; champions Ridgewood Water PFAS environmental compliance, transparent village management, and fiscal oversight.
councilCandidates.tagline: Rigorous legal oversight, clean drinking water filtration, and open government.
keyPlatformPillars: Overseeing multi-million dollar Ridgewood Water capital projects to ensure clean, PFAS-free drinking water.
Ensuring strict compliance with the statutory 2% tax levy cap and competitive public contract procurement.
verifiedSources: Village of Ridgewood Certified Council Roll

councilCandidates.name: Evan Weitz
councilCandidates.experience: Incumbent Village Councilman; former federal prosecutor and corporate compliance executive; focuses on public safety investments, traffic calming, and capital reserve planning.
councilCandidates.tagline: Prudent debt containment, first responder support, and pedestrian safety.
keyPlatformPillars: Restricting municipal bond issuance to maintain Ridgewood's premier AAA municipal credit rating.
Enhancing crosswalk safety signage and speed mitigation on key residential arteries.

councilCandidates.name: Siobhan Winograd
councilCandidates.experience: Incumbent Village Councilwoman; community historian, active school parent volunteer, and civic organizer; leads initiatives on open space, environmental sustainability, and historic preservation.
councilCandidates.tagline: Open space preservation, community engagement, and environmental stewardship.
keyPlatformPillars: Preserving Village parks and passive open space while upgrading recreational facilities for youth leagues.
Fostering civic engagement through regular community town halls and transparent committee reporting.

boeCandidates.name: Sheila Brogan
boeCandidates.term: Vote for up to 3 • 3-Year Full Term (2027–2029)
boeCandidates.experience: Distinguished veteran Ridgewood Board of Education President with over 20 years of dedicated service; recognized statewide for school governance leadership.
boeCandidates.keyFocus: Preserving Ridgewood's premier state and national academic rankings while managing a $132M budget.
boeCandidates.fiscalStance: Strict 2% tax levy cap compliance and strategic reserve allocation to avoid service cuts.
boeCandidates.infrastructureStance: Renovating aging school roofs, HVAC upgrades, and science lab modernizations across all 10 district facilities.

interviewStances.keyInterviewQuote: Our public schools are the heart of Ridgewood. We must protect our high academic standards while remaining mindful of our homeowners' property tax investments.
interviewStances.keyPriorities: Classroom excellence, special education inclusion, and student mental wellness.
interviewStances.facilitiesAndBudget: Transparent school budget forums and long-term facility capital plans.

boeCandidates.name: Muhammad Mahmoud
boeCandidates.term: Vote for up to 3 • 3-Year Full Term (2027–2029)
boeCandidates.experience: Ridgewood Board of Education Vice President; technology strategist and parent volunteer; champions STEM learning, computer science curricula, and school security.
boeCandidates.keyFocus: Integrating modern technology and artificial intelligence literacy into K-12 classrooms.
boeCandidates.fiscalStance: Optimizing operational expenditures through competitive technology vendor procurement.
boeCandidates.infrastructureStance: Campus perimeter security enhancements, digital access control, and modernized media centers.

interviewStances.keyInterviewQuote: Preparing Ridgewood students for the future requires modern tools, innovative educators, and fiscally sound school management.
interviewStances.keyPriorities: STEM curricula, student cybersecurity, and classroom technology.
interviewStances.facilitiesAndBudget: Zero-waste tech procurement and energy-efficient school operations.

boeCandidates.name: Saurabh Dani
boeCandidates.term: Vote for up to 3 • 3-Year Full Term (2027–2029)
boeCandidates.experience: Incumbent School Board Trustee; corporate engineer and active community volunteer; focuses on curriculum rigor, student wellness, and math acceleration.
boeCandidates.keyFocus: Advanced math and science pathways, transparent communication, and student mental wellness.
boeCandidates.fiscalStance: Ensuring educational dollars stay in the classroom and support teacher professional development.
boeCandidates.infrastructureStance: Modernizing elementary school playgrounds, HVAC ventilation, and cafeteria nutrition facilities.

interviewStances.keyInterviewQuote: Educational rigor and compassionate student support must go together. We are committed to lifting up every learner in Ridgewood.
interviewStances.keyPriorities: Curriculum standards, mental wellness counseling, and parent transparency.
interviewStances.facilitiesAndBudget: Strategic facilities master planning with community oversight.
